name: blipwick
description: Push notifications to your phone (via ntfy) when Claude Code finishes, needs your input, or stops on an error.

topic.title: ntfy topic
topic.description: The ntfy topic to publish to. Leave empty and one random, hard-to-guess topic is generated for you; run /notify-setup to see it.

server.title: ntfy server
server.description: The ntfy server URL. Use your own for self-hosted ntfy.

token.title: ntfy access token
token.description: Optional. An access token (tk_...) for a protected topic or self-hosted server.

notifyOn.title: When to notify
notifyOn.description: all: finished + needs input + errors. input-and-errors: skip 'finished'. errors: only when Claude stops on an error.

minTurnSeconds.title: Minimum turn length (seconds)
minTurnSeconds.description: Only send a 'finished' notification when the turn ran at least this long. 0 sends one after every turn; raise it (e.g. 30) so quick replies you are watching don't ping your phone.
